introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.text: This Privacy Policy explains how our application collects, uses, stores, and protects personal data when you use our services.

account.title: Account Information
account.text: When you create an account, we may collect information such as your username, password credentials, and other information required to create and manage your account.

profile.title: Profile Information
profile.text: Users may provide information for their profile, such as a profile picture or other profile information.

messages.title: Messages and Social Features
messages.text: When you use messaging and friendship features, we process the information necessary to provide these services, including messages, conversation participants, and friendship relationships.

game.title: Game Data
game.text: When you play games through the application, we may store information related to your games, such as game results, moves, scores, or other information required to provide game and statistics features.

ai.title: AI Conversations
ai.text: The application provides an AI-powered feature called "Imaginary Friend". When you use this feature, your messages are processed to generate AI responses.

analytics.title: Analytics and Usage Data
analytics.text: We may collect usage information related to your own activity in the application, such as AI usage, games, messages, or other statistics displayed through the application's analytics features.

technical.title: Technical Information
technical.text: The application may process technical information required to operate and secure the service, such as authentication information, session information, IP addresses, or server logs.

usage.title: 3. How We Use Information
usage.intro: We use the information we process for purposes including:

ai-services.title: 4. AI Services
ai-services.text: Our application uses an external AI service to generate responses for the "Imaginary Friend" feature.

third-party.title: 5. Third-Party Services
third-party.text: The application may use third-party services to provide specific functionality, such as AI services or authentication providers.

cookies.title: 6. Authentication and Cookies
cookies.text: The application uses authentication mechanisms, including cookies or similar technologies, to maintain authenticated sessions and protect user accounts.

retention.title: 7. Data Retention
retention.text: Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to provide the relevant functionality, maintain the application, comply with applicable obligations, or resolve security and operational issues.

security.title: 8. Data Security
security.text: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

rights.title: 9. User Rights
rights.intro: Depending on applicable data protection law, users may have rights concerning their personal information, including:

deletion.title: 10. Data Deletion
deletion.text: Users may request deletion of their account and associated personal information where applicable.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.text: We may update this Privacy Policy when the application or its data processing practices change.

contact.title: 12. Contact
contact.text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or the processing of your personal information, please contact the project team at:

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of These Terms
acceptance.text: By creating an account or using the application, you agree to these Terms of Service.

service.title: 2. Description of the Service
service.text: The application is a web-based social and gaming platform.

accounts.title: 3. User Accounts
accounts.text: Users are responsible for keeping their account credentials secure.

acceptable-use.title: 4. Acceptable Use
acceptable-use.intro: You agree to use the application responsibly and lawfully.

content.title: 5. User-Generated Content
content.text: Users may create or upload content such as profile information, profile pictures, and messages.

messaging.title: 6. Messaging and Social Features
messaging.text: Messaging and friendship features are intended for communication between users.

games.title: 7. Games
games.text: The application may provide online games such as Gomoku.

ai.title: 8. AI Features
ai.text: The application provides AI-powered functionality through the "Imaginary Friend" feature.

third-party.title: 9. Third-Party Services
third-party.text: Some application features may depend on third-party services.

availability.title: 10. Availability of the Service
availability.text: We aim to keep the application available and functional, but we do not guarantee that the service will always be available, uninterrupted, or error-free.

termination.title: 11. Account Suspension and Termination
termination.text: We may restrict, suspend, or terminate an account when necessary, including in cases of violation of these Terms of Service.

intellectual-property.title: 12. Intellectual Property
intellectual-property.text: The application, including its software, design, interface, logos, and other original materials, may be protected by applicable intellectual property laws.

liability.title: 13. Limitation of Liability
liability.text: The application is provided on an "as available" basis.

changes.title: 14. Changes to These Terms
changes.text: These Terms of Service may be updated when the application or its functionality changes.

contact.text: If you have questions about these Terms of Service, please contact the project team at:
